title: PIM product attributes, groups, families and custom fields
summary: Admin defines typed attributes, groups and families for products and categories; values reach shoppers only through publish. Showing a new attribute on the product page is a Webstore source change.
when_to_use: shared product data, filters, comparison, variants
shape the product form with families
not_for: a value per customer, account or order (Custom Table)
store, role or product-type switching (families are none of these)

evidence.note: ten key facts with sources and confidence

limitations: Type and Code are locked after first save
Management APIs for attributes, groups and families exist only in the legacy v1 reference
Stock product page renders a fixed set of tabs
platform_change_if: search or facet behaviour the search profile cannot express

unverified: behaviour on the customer's Znode version
per-type validation rules flagged by the research track
